parameterGuidance.name: steps
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how many denoising passes the sampler runs.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Can add detail and coherence, but costs time and may overcook texture.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Runs faster and can keep motion/video tests lighter, but may reduce detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Do not compare prompt changes while also changing steps unless you are testing runtime or detail.
parameterGuidance.example: The current SDXL OpenPose lane is around 24 steps; the Wan proof lanes use much lower steps.

parameterGuidance.name: cfg
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls prompt adherence versus model freedom.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Follows text more strongly, useful for missed setting/style cues.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Can look more natural and less brittle, useful for video or source-preserving work.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can create harsh texture, anatomy stress, or over-literal results.
parameterGuidance.example: Juggernaut still workflows have worked around 4.7-5.2; Wan video proofs are closer to 1-3.

parameterGuidance.name: sampler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Not numeric; swapping can make output sharper, smoother, or less stable.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

parameterGuidance.name: scheduler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Not numeric; swapping can make output sharper, smoother, or less stable.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

parameterGuidance.name: denoise
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how much the generation can depart from the source or latent.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Allows larger visual changes, stronger repair, or more reimagining.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Preserves identity, composition, lighting, and surrounding pixels.
parameterGuidance.warning: High denoise on source-guided work is the fastest path to identity drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Identity polish has worked low around 0.18-0.35; bigger inpaint repairs may need more.

parameterGuidance.name: lora_strength_model
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the LoRA changes model behavior or text conditioning.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Stronger style/identity/realism influence.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Less drift from the base checkpoint and source image.
parameterGuidance.warning: High LoRA strength can overpower subtle prompt changes.
parameterGuidance.example: Canopus has been useful as realism support; keep changes small when testing prompts.

parameterGuidance.name: lora_strength_clip
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the LoRA changes model behavior or text conditioning.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Stronger style/identity/realism influence.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Less drift from the base checkpoint and source image.
parameterGuidance.warning: High LoRA strength can overpower subtle prompt changes.
parameterGuidance.example: Canopus has been useful as realism support; keep changes small when testing prompts.

parameterGuidance.name: steps
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how many denoising passes the sampler runs.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Can add detail and coherence, but costs time and may overcook texture.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Runs faster and can keep motion/video tests lighter, but may reduce detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Do not compare prompt changes while also changing steps unless you are testing runtime or detail.

parameterGuidance.name: cfg
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls prompt adherence versus model freedom.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Follows text more strongly, useful for missed setting/style cues.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Can look more natural and less brittle, useful for video or source-preserving work.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can create harsh texture, anatomy stress, or over-literal results.
parameterGuidance.example: Juggernaut still workflows have worked around 4.7-5.2; Wan video proofs are closer to 1-3.

parameterGuidance.name: sampler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.

parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.

parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Allows larger visual changes, stronger repair, or more reimagining.

parameterGuidance.name: steps
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how many denoising passes the sampler runs.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Can add detail and coherence, but costs time and may overcook texture.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Runs faster and can keep motion/video tests lighter, but may reduce detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Do not compare prompt changes while also changing steps unless you are testing runtime or detail.
parameterGuidance.example: The current SDXL OpenPose lane is around 24 steps; the Wan proof lanes use much lower steps.

parameterGuidance.name: cfg
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls prompt adherence versus model freedom.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Follows text more strongly, useful for missed setting/style cues.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Can look more natural and less brittle, useful for video or source-preserving work.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can create harsh texture, anatomy stress, or over-literal results.
parameterGuidance.example: Juggernaut still workflows have worked around 4.7-5.2; Wan video proofs are closer to 1-3.

parameterGuidance.name: sampler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.

parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

slots.label: Setting

parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how many denoising passes the sampler runs.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Can add detail and coherence, but costs time and may overcook texture.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Runs faster and can keep motion/video tests lighter, but may reduce detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Do not compare prompt changes while also changing steps unless you are testing runtime or detail.
parameterGuidance.example: The current SDXL OpenPose lane is around 24 steps; the Wan proof lanes use much lower steps.

parameterGuidance.name: cfg
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls prompt adherence versus model freedom.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Follows text more strongly, useful for missed setting/style cues.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Can look more natural and less brittle, useful for video or source-preserving work.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can create harsh texture, anatomy stress, or over-literal results.
parameterGuidance.example: Juggernaut still workflows have worked around 4.7-5.2; Wan video proofs are closer to 1-3.

parameterGuidance.name: sampler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Not numeric; swapping can make output sharper, smoother, or less stable.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

parameterGuidance.name: denoise
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how much the generation can depart from the source or latent.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Allows larger visual changes, stronger repair, or more reimagining.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Preserves identity, composition, lighting, and surrounding pixels.

parameterGuidance.example: Identity polish has worked low around 0.18-0.35; bigger inpaint repairs may need more.

parameterGuidance.name: width

parameterGuidance.name: steps
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how many denoising passes the sampler runs.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Can add detail and coherence, but costs time and may overcook texture.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Runs faster and can keep motion/video tests lighter, but may reduce detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Do not compare prompt changes while also changing steps unless you are testing runtime or detail.
parameterGuidance.example: The current SDXL OpenPose lane is around 24 steps; the Wan proof lanes use much lower steps.

parameterGuidance.name: cfg
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls prompt adherence versus model freedom.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Follows text more strongly, useful for missed setting/style cues.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Can look more natural and less brittle, useful for video or source-preserving work.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can create harsh texture, anatomy stress, or over-literal results.
parameterGuidance.example: Juggernaut still workflows have worked around 4.7-5.2; Wan video proofs are closer to 1-3.

parameterGuidance.name: sampler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Not numeric; swapping can make output sharper, smoother, or less stable.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

parameterGuidance.name: denoise
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how much the generation can depart from the source or latent.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Allows larger visual changes, stronger repair, or more reimagining.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Preserves identity, composition, lighting, and surrounding pixels.
parameterGuidance.warning: High denoise on source-guided work is the fastest path to identity drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Identity polish has worked low around 0.18-0.35; bigger inpaint repairs may need more.

parameterGuidance.name: width
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls aspect ratio and the space available for body framing or video.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: More canvas space on that axis, but more compute.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Faster and sometimes more stable, but can crop subjects.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing aspect ratio can break OpenPose or video framing comparisons.

parameterGuidance.name: lora_strength_model

parameterGuidance.name: control_strength

slots.help: Describes what the subject is doing; OpenPose workflows should defer body placement to the reference image.
examples: standing naturally with relaxed shoulders
seated with a calm direct expression
subtle hair and posture movement for video

slots.label: Composition
slots.defaultValue: stable full-body composition with clean head-to-feet framing
slots.help: Controls crop, distance, body framing, and camera placement; this is critical for full-body/OpenPose work.
examples: vertical head-to-toe long shot
medium-full editorial portrait with room around the subject
full-body frame, both hands and feet visible

slots.label: Lighting
slots.defaultValue: soft natural light with realistic skin highlights
slots.help: Changes mood and realism without changing the workflow graph. Strong lighting phrases often have more impact than extra style tags.
examples: golden-hour side light
warm coffee shop window glow
low-key interior light with subtle rim separation

slots.label: Camera
slots.defaultValue: 50mm real camera photograph, natural depth of field

slots.label: Style / finish

examples: photorealistic editorial fashion finish
documentary realism with restrained color grade
fine-art natural skin texture

slots.defaultValue: lawful, fictional, clearly adult, consented, non-celebrity, non-public-figure, non-coercive, non-explicit-action
slots.help: Safety and production guardrails that should stay attached to every generated prompt.
examples: fictional adult-only subject
no public figure or real-person likeness
non-explicit editorial framing

parameterGuidance.name: steps
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how many denoising passes the sampler runs.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Can add detail and coherence, but costs time and may overcook texture.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Runs faster and can keep motion/video tests lighter, but may reduce detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Do not compare prompt changes while also changing steps unless you are testing runtime or detail.
parameterGuidance.example: The current SDXL OpenPose lane is around 24 steps; the Wan proof lanes use much lower steps.

parameterGuidance.name: cfg
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls prompt adherence versus model freedom.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Follows text more strongly, useful for missed setting/style cues.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Can look more natural and less brittle, useful for video or source-preserving work.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can create harsh texture, anatomy stress, or over-literal results.
parameterGuidance.example: Juggernaut still workflows have worked around 4.7-5.2; Wan video proofs are closer to 1-3.

parameterGuidance.name: sampler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Not numeric; swapping can make output sharper, smoother, or less stable.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

parameterGuidance.name: scheduler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Not numeric; swapping can make output sharper, smoother, or less stable.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

parameterGuidance.name: denoise
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how much the generation can depart from the source or latent.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Allows larger visual changes, stronger repair, or more reimagining.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Preserves identity, composition, lighting, and surrounding pixels.
parameterGuidance.warning: High denoise on source-guided work is the fastest path to identity drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Identity polish has worked low around 0.18-0.35; bigger inpaint repairs may need more.

parameterGuidance.name: width
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls aspect ratio and the space available for body framing or video.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: More canvas space on that axis, but more compute.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Faster and sometimes more stable, but can crop subjects.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing aspect ratio can break OpenPose or video framing comparisons.
parameterGuidance.example: The strongest OpenPose stills use tall vertical framing; selected Wan outputs use compact video dimensions.

parameterGuidance.name: height
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls aspect ratio and the space available for body framing or video.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: More canvas space on that axis, but more compute.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Faster and sometimes more stable, but can crop subjects.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing aspect ratio can break OpenPose or video framing comparisons.
parameterGuidance.example: The strongest OpenPose stills use tall vertical framing; selected Wan outputs use compact video dimensions.

parameterGuidance.name: lora_strength_model
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the LoRA changes model behavior or text conditioning.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Stronger style/identity/realism influence.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Less drift from the base checkpoint and source image.
parameterGuidance.warning: High LoRA strength can overpower subtle prompt changes.
parameterGuidance.example: Canopus has been useful as realism support; keep changes small when testing prompts.

parameterGuidance.name: lora_strength_clip
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the LoRA changes model behavior or text conditioning.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Stronger style/identity/realism influence.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Less drift from the base checkpoint and source image.
parameterGuidance.warning: High LoRA strength can overpower subtle prompt changes.
parameterGuidance.example: Canopus has been useful as realism support; keep changes small when testing prompts.

parameterGuidance.name: control_strength
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the OpenPose reference anchors the body geometry.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Better pose accuracy and full-body discipline.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: More creative freedom and less rigid body placement.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can make anatomy stiff; too low can lose hands, feet, or pose.
parameterGuidance.example: The production OpenPose lane has worked around 0.82; flexible pose tests can run lower.

parameterGuidance.name: control_start
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls when the pose/control signal is active during sampling.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: For end percent, keeps pose influence active longer.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: For end percent, releases the model earlier for softer detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing timing can look like a prompt failure when it is really control timing drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Current OpenPose graphs generally start at 0 and end near 0.95-1.0.

parameterGuidance.name: control_end
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls when the pose/control signal is active during sampling.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: For end percent, keeps pose influence active longer.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: For end percent, releases the model earlier for softer detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing timing can look like a prompt failure when it is really control timing drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Current OpenPose graphs generally start at 0 and end near 0.95-1.0.

slots.label: Subject / look
slots.defaultValue: fictional clearly adult editorial subject with mature styling
slots.help: Controls identity lane, age presentation, body type, styling, and the model/look language without changing workflow mechanics.
examples: fictional clearly adult girl-next-door fashion subject, late-20s or older styling

fictional rubenesque mature woman with tasteful fashion styling

slots.label: Setting
slots.defaultValue: clean editorial environment with uncluttered background separation
slots.help: Changes location and environmental context; keep it concise so pose/control inputs still dominate structure.
examples: secluded beach at golden hour
cozy coffee shop corner with warm window light
low-key boudoir interior with tasteful directional light

slots.label: Action / pose
slots.defaultValue: calm controlled pose with natural expression
slots.help: Describes what the subject is doing; OpenPose workflows should defer body placement to the reference image.
examples: standing naturally with relaxed shoulders
seated with a calm direct expression
subtle hair and posture movement for video

slots.label: Composition
slots.defaultValue: stable full-body composition with clean head-to-feet framing
slots.help: Controls crop, distance, body framing, and camera placement; this is critical for full-body/OpenPose work.
examples: vertical head-to-toe long shot
medium-full editorial portrait with room around the subject
full-body frame, both hands and feet visible

slots.label: Lighting
slots.defaultValue: soft natural light with realistic skin highlights
slots.help: Changes mood and realism without changing the workflow graph. Strong lighting phrases often have more impact than extra style tags.
examples: golden-hour side light
warm coffee shop window glow
low-key interior light with subtle rim separation

slots.label: Camera
slots.defaultValue: 50mm real camera photograph, natural depth of field
slots.help: Controls lens feel, distance, and photographic language; use one camera idea at a time.
examples: 50mm documentary photograph
85mm shallow depth of field
camera pulled back, stable full-body framing

slots.label: Style / finish
slots.defaultValue: photorealistic, natural skin texture, restrained color grade
slots.help: Controls render finish. Keep it realistic and restrained for Juggernaut/Canopus lanes.
examples: photorealistic editorial fashion finish
documentary realism with restrained color grade
fine-art natural skin texture

slots.label: Constraints
slots.defaultValue: lawful, fictional, clearly adult, consented, non-celebrity, non-public-figure, non-coercive, non-explicit-action
slots.help: Safety and production guardrails that should stay attached to every generated prompt.
examples: fictional adult-only subject
no public figure or real-person likeness
non-explicit editorial framing

keep head-to-feet full-body framing with both hands and feet in frame
let the prompt change setting, styling, lighting, and camera while the reference controls body geometry

parameterGuidance.name: steps
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how many denoising passes the sampler runs.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Can add detail and coherence, but costs time and may overcook texture.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Runs faster and can keep motion/video tests lighter, but may reduce detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Do not compare prompt changes while also changing steps unless you are testing runtime or detail.
parameterGuidance.example: The current SDXL OpenPose lane is around 24 steps; the Wan proof lanes use much lower steps.

parameterGuidance.name: cfg
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls prompt adherence versus model freedom.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Follows text more strongly, useful for missed setting/style cues.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Can look more natural and less brittle, useful for video or source-preserving work.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can create harsh texture, anatomy stress, or over-literal results.
parameterGuidance.example: Juggernaut still workflows have worked around 4.7-5.2; Wan video proofs are closer to 1-3.

parameterGuidance.name: sampler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Not numeric; swapping can make output sharper, smoother, or less stable.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

parameterGuidance.name: scheduler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Not numeric; swapping can make output sharper, smoother, or less stable.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

parameterGuidance.name: denoise
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how much the generation can depart from the source or latent.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Allows larger visual changes, stronger repair, or more reimagining.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Preserves identity, composition, lighting, and surrounding pixels.
parameterGuidance.warning: High denoise on source-guided work is the fastest path to identity drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Identity polish has worked low around 0.18-0.35; bigger inpaint repairs may need more.

parameterGuidance.name: width
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls aspect ratio and the space available for body framing or video.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: More canvas space on that axis, but more compute.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Faster and sometimes more stable, but can crop subjects.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing aspect ratio can break OpenPose or video framing comparisons.
parameterGuidance.example: The strongest OpenPose stills use tall vertical framing; selected Wan outputs use compact video dimensions.

parameterGuidance.name: height
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls aspect ratio and the space available for body framing or video.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: More canvas space on that axis, but more compute.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Faster and sometimes more stable, but can crop subjects.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing aspect ratio can break OpenPose or video framing comparisons.
parameterGuidance.example: The strongest OpenPose stills use tall vertical framing; selected Wan outputs use compact video dimensions.

parameterGuidance.name: lora_strength_model
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the LoRA changes model behavior or text conditioning.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Stronger style/identity/realism influence.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Less drift from the base checkpoint and source image.
parameterGuidance.warning: High LoRA strength can overpower subtle prompt changes.
parameterGuidance.example: Canopus has been useful as realism support; keep changes small when testing prompts.

parameterGuidance.name: lora_strength_clip
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the LoRA changes model behavior or text conditioning.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Stronger style/identity/realism influence.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Less drift from the base checkpoint and source image.
parameterGuidance.warning: High LoRA strength can overpower subtle prompt changes.
parameterGuidance.example: Canopus has been useful as realism support; keep changes small when testing prompts.

parameterGuidance.name: control_strength
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the OpenPose reference anchors the body geometry.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Better pose accuracy and full-body discipline.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: More creative freedom and less rigid body placement.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can make anatomy stiff; too low can lose hands, feet, or pose.
parameterGuidance.example: The production OpenPose lane has worked around 0.82; flexible pose tests can run lower.

parameterGuidance.name: control_start
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls when the pose/control signal is active during sampling.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: For end percent, keeps pose influence active longer.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: For end percent, releases the model earlier for softer detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing timing can look like a prompt failure when it is really control timing drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Current OpenPose graphs generally start at 0 and end near 0.95-1.0.

parameterGuidance.name: control_end
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls when the pose/control signal is active during sampling.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: For end percent, keeps pose influence active longer.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: For end percent, releases the model earlier for softer detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing timing can look like a prompt failure when it is really control timing drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Current OpenPose graphs generally start at 0 and end near 0.95-1.0.

parameterGuidance.name: steps
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how many denoising passes the sampler runs.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Can add detail and coherence, but costs time and may overcook texture.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Runs faster and can keep motion/video tests lighter, but may reduce detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Do not compare prompt changes while also changing steps unless you are testing runtime or detail.
parameterGuidance.example: The current SDXL OpenPose lane is around 24 steps; the Wan proof lanes use much lower steps.

parameterGuidance.name: cfg
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls prompt adherence versus model freedom.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Follows text more strongly, useful for missed setting/style cues.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Can look more natural and less brittle, useful for video or source-preserving work.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can create harsh texture, anatomy stress, or over-literal results.
parameterGuidance.example: Juggernaut still workflows have worked around 4.7-5.2; Wan video proofs are closer to 1-3.

parameterGuidance.name: sampler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Not numeric; swapping can make output sharper, smoother, or less stable.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

parameterGuidance.name: scheduler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Not numeric; swapping can make output sharper, smoother, or less stable.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

parameterGuidance.name: denoise
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how much the generation can depart from the source or latent.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Allows larger visual changes, stronger repair, or more reimagining.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Preserves identity, composition, lighting, and surrounding pixels.
parameterGuidance.warning: High denoise on source-guided work is the fastest path to identity drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Identity polish has worked low around 0.18-0.35; bigger inpaint repairs may need more.

parameterGuidance.name: width
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls aspect ratio and the space available for body framing or video.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: More canvas space on that axis, but more compute.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Faster and sometimes more stable, but can crop subjects.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing aspect ratio can break OpenPose or video framing comparisons.
parameterGuidance.example: The strongest OpenPose stills use tall vertical framing; selected Wan outputs use compact video dimensions.

parameterGuidance.name: height
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls aspect ratio and the space available for body framing or video.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: More canvas space on that axis, but more compute.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Faster and sometimes more stable, but can crop subjects.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing aspect ratio can break OpenPose or video framing comparisons.
parameterGuidance.example: The strongest OpenPose stills use tall vertical framing; selected Wan outputs use compact video dimensions.

parameterGuidance.name: control_strength
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the OpenPose reference anchors the body geometry.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Better pose accuracy and full-body discipline.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: More creative freedom and less rigid body placement.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can make anatomy stiff; too low can lose hands, feet, or pose.
parameterGuidance.example: The production OpenPose lane has worked around 0.82; flexible pose tests can run lower.

parameterGuidance.name: control_start
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls when the pose/control signal is active during sampling.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: For end percent, keeps pose influence active longer.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: For end percent, releases the model earlier for softer detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing timing can look like a prompt failure when it is really control timing drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Current OpenPose graphs generally start at 0 and end near 0.95-1.0.

parameterGuidance.name: control_end
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls when the pose/control signal is active during sampling.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: For end percent, keeps pose influence active longer.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: For end percent, releases the model earlier for softer detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing timing can look like a prompt failure when it is really control timing drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Current OpenPose graphs generally start at 0 and end near 0.95-1.0.

parameterGuidance.name: lora_strength_model
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the LoRA changes model behavior or text conditioning.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Stronger style/identity/realism influence.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Less drift from the base checkpoint and source image.
parameterGuidance.warning: High LoRA strength can overpower subtle prompt changes.
parameterGuidance.example: Canopus has been useful as realism support; keep changes small when testing prompts.

parameterGuidance.name: lora_strength_clip
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the LoRA changes model behavior or text conditioning.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Stronger style/identity/realism influence.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Less drift from the base checkpoint and source image.
parameterGuidance.warning: High LoRA strength can overpower subtle prompt changes.
parameterGuidance.example: Canopus has been useful as realism support; keep changes small when testing prompts.

promptPreview.positive: photorealistic fine-art boudoir nude photograph of Avery, a clearly adult fictional blonde woman lying outdoors on a thick cream wool blanket in a private summer meadow, relaxed supine butterfly pose with arms raised and hands in her hair, same body placement...
promptPreview.negative: minor, teen, child, youth-coded, barely legal, childlike face, babyface, celebrity, public figure, real person likeness, other people, crowd, bystanders, explicit sex act, intercourse, penetration, pornographic close-up, graphic genital focus, spread anatomy...

slots.label: Subject / look
slots.defaultValue: fictional clearly adult editorial subject with mature styling
slots.help: Controls identity lane, age presentation, body type, styling, and the model/look language without changing workflow mechanics.
examples: fictional clearly adult girl-next-door fashion subject, late-20s or older styling
fictional mature hipster editorial woman with layered casual styling
fictional rubenesque mature woman with tasteful fashion styling

slots.label: Setting
slots.defaultValue: clean editorial environment with uncluttered background separation
slots.help: Changes location and environmental context; keep it concise so pose/control inputs still dominate structure.
examples: secluded beach at golden hour
cozy coffee shop corner with warm window light
low-key boudoir interior with tasteful directional light

slots.label: Action / pose
slots.defaultValue: calm controlled pose with natural expression
slots.help: Describes what the subject is doing; OpenPose workflows should defer body placement to the reference image.
examples: standing naturally with relaxed shoulders
seated with a calm direct expression
subtle hair and posture movement for video

slots.label: Composition
slots.defaultValue: stable full-body composition with clean head-to-feet framing
slots.help: Controls crop, distance, body framing, and camera placement; this is critical for full-body/OpenPose work.
examples: vertical head-to-toe long shot
medium-full editorial portrait with room around the subject
full-body frame, both hands and feet visible

slots.label: Lighting
slots.defaultValue: soft natural light with realistic skin highlights
slots.help: Changes mood and realism without changing the workflow graph. Strong lighting phrases often have more impact than extra style tags.
examples: golden-hour side light
warm coffee shop window glow
low-key interior light with subtle rim separation

slots.label: Camera
slots.defaultValue: 50mm real camera photograph, natural depth of field
slots.help: Controls lens feel, distance, and photographic language; use one camera idea at a time.
examples: 50mm documentary photograph
85mm shallow depth of field
camera pulled back, stable full-body framing

slots.label: Style / finish
slots.defaultValue: photorealistic, natural skin texture, restrained color grade
slots.help: Controls render finish. Keep it realistic and restrained for Juggernaut/Canopus lanes.
examples: photorealistic editorial fashion finish
documentary realism with restrained color grade
fine-art natural skin texture

slots.label: Constraints
slots.defaultValue: lawful, fictional, clearly adult, consented, non-celebrity, non-public-figure, non-coercive, non-explicit-action
slots.help: Safety and production guardrails that should stay attached to every generated prompt.
examples: fictional adult-only subject
no public figure or real-person likeness
non-explicit editorial framing

promptNotes: Keep the subject, setting, composition, lighting, camera, and style clauses distinct so individual changes are easy to test.

parameterGuidance.name: steps
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how many denoising passes the sampler runs.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Can add detail and coherence, but costs time and may overcook texture.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Runs faster and can keep motion/video tests lighter, but may reduce detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Do not compare prompt changes while also changing steps unless you are testing runtime or detail.
parameterGuidance.example: The current SDXL OpenPose lane is around 24 steps; the Wan proof lanes use much lower steps.

parameterGuidance.name: cfg
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls prompt adherence versus model freedom.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Follows text more strongly, useful for missed setting/style cues.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Can look more natural and less brittle, useful for video or source-preserving work.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can create harsh texture, anatomy stress, or over-literal results.
parameterGuidance.example: Juggernaut still workflows have worked around 4.7-5.2; Wan video proofs are closer to 1-3.

parameterGuidance.name: sampler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Not numeric; swapping can make output sharper, smoother, or less stable.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

parameterGuidance.name: scheduler
parameterGuidance.recommendedRange: Keep current unless deliberately testing sampler behavior
parameterGuidance.effect: Changes the sampling path and texture/contrast character.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Not numeric; swapping can make output sharper, smoother, or less stable.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Not numeric; revert to the known-good pair for comparisons.
parameterGuidance.warning: Sampler changes can hide whether the prompt structure actually improved.
parameterGuidance.example: SDXL stills have worked with dpmpp_2m_sde + karras; some inpaint lanes use dpmpp_2m.

parameterGuidance.name: denoise
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how much the generation can depart from the source or latent.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Allows larger visual changes, stronger repair, or more reimagining.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Preserves identity, composition, lighting, and surrounding pixels.
parameterGuidance.warning: High denoise on source-guided work is the fastest path to identity drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Identity polish has worked low around 0.18-0.35; bigger inpaint repairs may need more.

parameterGuidance.name: width
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls aspect ratio and the space available for body framing or video.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: More canvas space on that axis, but more compute.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Faster and sometimes more stable, but can crop subjects.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing aspect ratio can break OpenPose or video framing comparisons.
parameterGuidance.example: The strongest OpenPose stills use tall vertical framing; selected Wan outputs use compact video dimensions.

parameterGuidance.name: height
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls aspect ratio and the space available for body framing or video.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: More canvas space on that axis, but more compute.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Faster and sometimes more stable, but can crop subjects.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing aspect ratio can break OpenPose or video framing comparisons.
parameterGuidance.example: The strongest OpenPose stills use tall vertical framing; selected Wan outputs use compact video dimensions.

parameterGuidance.name: control_strength
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the OpenPose reference anchors the body geometry.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Better pose accuracy and full-body discipline.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: More creative freedom and less rigid body placement.
parameterGuidance.warning: Too high can make anatomy stiff; too low can lose hands, feet, or pose.
parameterGuidance.example: The production OpenPose lane has worked around 0.82; flexible pose tests can run lower.

parameterGuidance.name: control_start
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls when the pose/control signal is active during sampling.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: For end percent, keeps pose influence active longer.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: For end percent, releases the model earlier for softer detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing timing can look like a prompt failure when it is really control timing drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Current OpenPose graphs generally start at 0 and end near 0.95-1.0.

parameterGuidance.name: control_end
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls when the pose/control signal is active during sampling.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: For end percent, keeps pose influence active longer.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: For end percent, releases the model earlier for softer detail.
parameterGuidance.warning: Changing timing can look like a prompt failure when it is really control timing drift.
parameterGuidance.example: Current OpenPose graphs generally start at 0 and end near 0.95-1.0.

parameterGuidance.name: lora_strength_model
parameterGuidance.effect: Controls how strongly the LoRA changes model behavior or text conditioning.
parameterGuidance.increaseEffect: Stronger style/identity/realism influence.
parameterGuidance.decreaseEffect: Less drift from the base checkpoint and source image.
parameterGuidance.warning: High LoRA strength can overpower subtle prompt changes.
parameterGuidance.example: Canopus has been useful as realism support; keep changes small when testing prompts.
